Rañada † \dagger\,, Mariano Santander ‡ \ddagger\, [2pt] † \dagger Departamento de Física Teórica and IUMA, Facultad de CienciasUniversidad de Zaragoza, 50009 Zaragoza, Spain [2pt] ‡ \ddagger Departamento de Física Teórica and IMUVa, Facultad de CienciasUniver
arxiv-2109-04937.description: Abstract We study four particular 3-dimensional natural Hamiltonian systems defined in conformally Euclidean spaces. We prove their superintegrability and we obtain, in the four cases, the maximal number of functionally independent integrals of motion. The two first systems are related to the 3-dimensional isotropic oscillator and the superintegrability is quadratic.

pmc-13395641.creator: Emanuel Miranda Oliveira, Luan Carrijo Ferreira, Mateus Caetano Silva, Wallisen Tadashi Hattori
pmc-13395641.description: ObjectiveThe increasing prevalence of polypharmacy and potentially inappropriate medications (PIMs) among older adults in Primary Health Care (PHC) poses significant risks to older patients.
